Exercise: Sit Squats

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_lower_body

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- abductors
- glutes
- hamstrings

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
3

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- lower_body_flexibility
- quadriceps_strengthening

Contraindications:

- condition: knee pain, description: Individuals with knee pain should consult a healthcare professional before attempting this exercise.

Exercise Variations:

- name: Wall-Assisted Sit Squats, instructions: ['Stand with your back against a wall. This will be your starting position.', 'Begin the movement by flexing your knees and hips, sitting back with your hips.', 'Continue until you have squatted a portion of the way down, but are above parallel, and quickly reverse the motion until you return to the starting position. Repeat for 5-10 repetitions.']

Substitution Options:

- name: Bodyweight Squats, force: push, level: beginner

Instructions:

- Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
- Begin the movement by flexing your knees and hips, sitting back with your hips.
- Continue until you have squatted a portion of the way down, but are above parallel, and quickly reverse the motion until you return to the starting position. Repeat for 5-10 repetitions.
